mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( product_type, fin_co_no, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, fin_prdt_nm, join_way, mtrt_int, spcl_cnd, join_member, etc_note, max_limit ) VALUES ( 'DEPOSIT', #{financialCompanyNumber}, #{productCode}, #{financialCompanyName}, #{productName}, #{joinWay}, #{maturityInterestDescription}, #{preferentialConditions}, #{joinMember}, #{additionalNote}, #{maxLimit} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kor_co_nm = #{financialCompanyName}, fin_prdt_nm = #{productName}, join_way = #{joinWay}, mtrt_int = #{maturityInterestDescription}, spcl_cnd = #{preferentialConditions}, join_member = #{joinMember}, etc_note = #{additionalNote}, max_limit = #{maxLimit}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_type, kor_co_nm AS financial_company_name, fin_prdt_nm AS product_name, join_way, mtrt_int AS maturity_interest_description, spcl_cnd AS preferential_conditions, join_member, etc_note AS additional_note, max_limit FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_type = #{productType}

SELECT product_option_id, intr_rate_type AS interest_rate_type, intr_rate_type_nm AS interest_rate_type_name, rsrv_type AS reserve_type, rsrv_type_nm AS reserve_type_name, save_trm AS saving_term, intr_rate AS interest_rate, intr_rate2 AS maximum_interest_rate FROM product_options WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY save_trm ASC, intr_rate_type ASC, rsrv_type ASC
